ModMetaData.name: Squirrel Variety Pack Renew
ModMetaData.author: SirTalis - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Six small woodland animals, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6: four squirrels, a flying squirrel and a groundhog.
I am not the author of this mod. All six animals are SirTalis's; all I did was the work needed to make them run on 1.6. Credit goes to them, mistakes in the update are mine. If they come back to it, or ask me to take this down, it comes down.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2737993245 - last supporting 1.3, last updated in February 2022. Abandoned, not withdrawn.
WHAT IT ADDS
Six animals, each in its own biome rather than scattered everywhere.
- The North American gray squirrel, in temperate and boreal forest, which comes in three coats: grey, black, and a white one at half a percent. - The Douglas squirrel, boreal forest. - The pine squirrel, boreal and temperate forest. - The southwestern red squirrel, arid shrubland. - The flying squirrel, temperate forest: worth 250 silver and moving at 11.1 cells per second, which is faster than anything else in the game. - The groundhog, temperate forest and swamp: body size 0.3, fourteen years, and a move speed of 1.2 - slower than a walking colonist.
If [XND] Nocturnal Animals is installed, the flying squirrel hunts at night.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE 1.6 UPDATE
Three things.
Wildness stopped being a field of RaceProperties in 1.6 and became a StatDef declared under statBases. The old form is not an error, it is simply never read, and the stat defaults to -1, outside the range the game uses - so all six tamed for almost nothing.
The gray squirrel's three coats changed hands. They came from AnimalVariations.dll, a library shipped without sources that does not survive the render tree RimWorld moved to in 1.5. Vanilla has done the same job natively since 1.4, so the coats are declared as alternateGraphics with the draw weights the old SkinSet file used: grey 1.0, black 0.4, albino 0.005. The DLL is gone and nothing else changed.
And the Nocturnal Animals patch works for the first time. It named only the mod's title from before Mlie took it over, so it never matched anything, and it added its extension directly under ThingDef instead of under modExtensions. Both fixed.
No balance value was changed.
Content mod: removing it mid-save will lose any of these six animals already in play.
Source, changelog and the full account of the port: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Squirrel-Variety-Pack-Renew
The original states no licence anywhere - no file, nothing in its About, no repository, nothing on its Workshop page. This port therefore rests on the Workshop's own custom for abandoned mods: named credit to the author, and a takedown on request.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
